ux_hard_requirements: Wizard screen 2 includes Open ChatGPT MCP App Page
Dashboard always shows administrator privilege runtime status
Privilege status reflects actual PrivilegeState, not only selected permission mode
User-facing UI uses Simplified Chinese except necessary professional abbreviations and proper names
No unnecessary English UI labels or internal enum strings
Dashboard exposes one current-task status panel
Current-task UI is status-only; no recent activity feed or history list
Task summary is grounded in actual MCP/Broker execution and secret-redacted
known_risks: Upstream coding-tools-mcp public release differs from GPT-WebCodex vendored version
Full mode process execution has current Windows user OS permissions
Guard may become a partial MCP implementation if upstream enforcement is insufficient
Windows junction/symlink/reparse points can undermine naive workspace path checks
Portable Python may differ materially from system Python
ChatGPT settings deep link may drift
engineering_hard_requirements: First-principles reasoning before implementation
No short-term patch-only production code; design for maintenance and iteration
UI uses minimum necessary buttons and minimum necessary prompts
Administrator operations use a separate privileged broker; no forced expiry timer; user enables/disables explicitly
All product runtimes are bundled; no system Python dependency
Third-party runtimes only upgrade with a full LocalBridge release
Windows 11 x64 only for v0.1
No telemetry or automatic updater in v0.1
Use system WebView2; do not bundle WebView2 runtime
Architecture invariants must become automated checks where feasible
Every upstream runtime upgrade requires a compatibility and capability diff
Persistent state is schema-versioned and migrated sequentially
External runtimes are isolated behind stable adapters
Stable releases include SBOM, third-party notices, provenance and exact runtime manifest
Runtime API Key never persists in plaintext and never appears in process CLI arguments
Remembered project list is not an authorization list
Exactly zero or one active workspace is authorized at a time
Removing a project never deletes disk files
Removing the active project enters NoActiveWorkspace and does not auto-authorize another project
G4 remains blocked after G3 adversarial PASS until a separate human manual/detail review is accepted as PASS
Human review treats user/executor factual claims as untrusted evidence and requires user-audited concrete executor pre-authorizations

Windows process ownership: Job Object exact design
Tunnel Runtime Key safe injection path
